applies_why: This judge text uses the two aspects of Isaiah 7:14 as a reason to label the link UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open: I weighed whether the challenger's virgin/young-woman wording and the defender's prophetic application are separate chain issues allowing UNDERDETERMINED, or two senses of Isaiah 7:14 that both stand and cannot make the verse open.
why: The judge declares UNDERDETERMINED by splitting the challenger's virgin/young-woman wording from the defender's prophetic application, treating Isaiah 7:14's dual senses as unresolved even though K-S2 says such a verse is not open and both senses stand.
